promotion.gemini_video_prompt: Generate a VERTICAL 9:16 video for Instagram Reels. Aspect ratio: 9:16, vertical portrait orientation. Duration: 8 to 10 seconds. A confident Indian heavy equipment operator in a safety helmet and high-visibility vest inspects an electric vehicle screen before smiling warmly. Smooth camera pan and subtle push-in shot highlighting natural movements. Ambient sound of modern machinery and energetic corporate background music. Ends with clean ChalakSetu visual branding and website chalaksetu.in on screen.
promotion.chatgpt_poster_prompt: Create a professional vertical 9:16 Instagram poster. Set in a realistic Indian industrial project site with modern electric heavy commercial trucks and electric machinery in the background. In the foreground, a professional Indian heavy equipment operator wearing modern safety equipment looks confident. Professional advertising composition with sleek modern typography, cyan electric energy accents, and warm daylight visual tone. Include prominent ChalakSetu branding and logo, bold readable headline 'EV & Heavy Equipment Operators Platform', and official website chalaksetu.in clearly visible at the bottom. Premium design, high quality, zero spelling mistakes.
